Name: Secret Marriage
Author: YuuKyow
Description:
[center][size=6][b]SECRET MARRIAGE[/b][/size]
[size=4]秘密婚姻 · 陪伴与共同生活[/size]
 
建立一段不必搬入农舍的秘密婚姻；在愿意相伴的夜晚，留一盏灯、一张床，或一间亲手布置的小屋。 
Choose a secret marriage without moving your partner into the farmhouse, then make room for shared evenings, guest sheds and everyday companionship.
 
[size=5][b]WHAT'S INCLUDED? · 有哪些内容？[/b][/size]
[left][list]
1.Your relationship, your choice · 自己决定关系 — 正式结婚或秘密结婚，多名秘密伴侣与一名正式配偶并存，十四心及自定义称呼。Official or secret marriage, multiple secret partners alongside one official spouse, fourteen hearts and custom social labels.[/list][/left]
[list=1]
2.An evening together · 一起度过夜晚 — 晚间留宿剧情、床位邀请、借床及晨间陪伴。Evening scenes, bed invitations, temporary bed borrowing and morning interactions.[/list][list]
3.A place to stay · 为对方留一间小屋 — 命名小屋、赠送钥匙、小住或长居；新增带固定套房的伴侣小屋。Named guest sheds, keys, short visits, residency and a new shed with an attached companion suite.[/list][list]
4.Rooms that feel lived in · 让家具融入生活 — 区域规划、家具用途、休息、电视、阅读、做饭等活动。Room planning, furniture roles, resting, television, reading, cooking and more.[/list][list]
5.Decorate your way · 自由布置伴侣空间 — 预览、放置或更换伴侣房间与露台，清空后自行装修。Preview, place and change partner rooms or patios, or clear their decorations and furnish them yourself.[/list][list]
6.A day of their own · 自由的一天 — 可选自由日，让符合条件的住客和配偶在农场或镇上活动。Optional free days let eligible visitors and your spouse spend time around the farm or town.[/list][list]
7.A shared diary · 一本记录大家的日程本 — 头像切换、日期历史、属性、活动时间轴与统计。Switch characters, browse dates, check care values and read timelines and summaries.[/list][list]
8.Care and character perks · 照料与角色回馈 — 三项属性及 34 位原版角色专属加成，另有表情、招呼和门口赠礼。Three care values and unique perks for 34 vanilla characters, with mood reactions, greetings and doorstep gifts.[/list][list]
9.Small moments · 更多相处片段 — 山顶同行与邀约、可选动态睡眠、礼物来源反应、来信及姜岛陪伴。Summit companionship and dates, optional dynamic sleep, gift provenance reactions, letters and Ginger Island visits. [/list] 
[size=4][b]细节、触发条件与剧情提示在下方折叠区。[/b][/size]
Details, requirements and story hints are in the spoilers below.
 
[size=5][b]RELATIONSHIPS · 关系选择[/b][/size]
[spoiler]
[b]求婚 / Proposals[/b]
赠送对应求婚道具时，可选择搬入农场，或维持现状。秘密结婚不举办婚礼，也不会仅因秘密关系扩建农舍或添加配偶房间。可以拥有多名秘密伴侣，同时保留一名正式配偶。
When giving the appropriate proposal item, choose farm life together or a secret relationship. Secret marriage does not hold a wedding or automatically add a spouse room. Multiple secret partners can coexist with one official spouse.
 
[b]十四心与事件 / Fourteen hearts and events[/b]
秘密伴侣可达到十四心，社交面板支持相应显示；已适配部分婚姻事件判断。
Secret partners can reach fourteen hearts, with social-page support and adaptations for some marriage event checks.
 
[b]称呼 / Social labels[/b]
可为符合条件的 NPC 选择或自定义显示标签。
Choose or write social labels for eligible NPCs.
 
[b]转正与解除s / Changing your mind[/b]
可再次求婚申请转为正式配偶；使用枯萎花束可解除秘密关系，扣除六心，并保留相应分手对白。解除后仍保留恋爱身份，再送一次按原版分手处理。Propose again to request official marriage. A Wilted Bouquet ends a secret relationship and deducts six hearts, with breakup dialogue; the dating relationship remains until another bouquet ends it under the normal rules.
 
[b]吊坠购买 / Pendant purchasing[/b]
支持婚后继续购买求婚吊坠，并提供可选的全天候购买设置。
Pendant purchasing remains available after marriage, with an optional any-weather setting.[/spoiler]
 
[size=5][b]STAY THE NIGHT · 今晚留下来吗？[/b][/size]
床位邀请、随机到访和农舍钥匙，提供不同的相处方式。
Bed invitations, random visits and farmhouse keys offer different ways to spend time together.
[spoiler]
[b]晚间剧情 / Evening scenes — story hints[/b]
没有正式配偶时，18:00 后进入自己的农舍，可能触发秘密伴侣敲门，或由你选择邀请一位秘密伴侣来陪伴。
Without an official spouse, entering your farmhouse after 6 PM can lead to a secret partner at the door, or a choice to invite someone yourself.
[b]主动邀请与随机人数 / Manual invitations and random counts[/b]
通过家具规划图纸分配床位后，右键床位邀请符合条件的角色。有正式配偶时能否随机留宿、不可婚角色能否在农舍留宿，均可设置。
Assign a bed with the Furniture Planning Blueprint, then right-click it to invite an eligible guest. Settings control random guests while officially married and non-marriageable farmhouse guests.
 
随机来客在到访后也先活动；如果到访时已经很晚，可能很快准备睡觉。具体可用床、同床设置、NPC 当前活动与当晚预约都影响结果。
Random guests also receive evening activity time. Very late arrivals may prepare for bed soon after arriving. Bed availability, sharing settings, existing activities and nightly reservations still apply.
 
[b]床位容量与借床 / Capacity and borrowing[/b]
农舍访客人数上限为可用床家具件数减一，最低为零。双人床算一件家具。临时借床优先顺序：给该 NPC 的双人床、无标记双人床、给该 NPC 的单人床、他人双人床、无标记单人床。可借正式配偶的空位，不借他人专属单人床，不覆盖标记。
Farmhouse guest capacity is the number of usable bed furniture pieces minus one, never below zero. A double bed counts as one piece. Borrowing prefers the guest's double bed, an unassigned double, their single bed, another person's double, then an unassigned single. Empty official-spouse space may be borrowed; assigned single beds and existing labels are respected.
 
[b]农舍钥匙 / Farmhouse keys[/b]
八心、没有正式配偶时可以赠送农舍钥匙。它提供小住许可，不提供永久农舍同居；之后正式结婚也不会删除原有钥匙许可。
Farmhouse keys require eight hearts and no official spouse when given. They grant visiting permission, not permanent farmhouse residency. Existing permissions survive later marriage.
 
[b]去 NPC 家过夜 / Staying at an NPC's home[/b]
完整版保留十心后去可婚 NPC 家中过夜的入口。
The Full edition retains an overnight option at a marriage candidate's home after ten hearts.[/spoiler]
 
[size=5][b]GUEST SHEDS · 小屋与入住[/b][/size]
为伴侣或朋友准备自己的空间，交给他们一把钥匙。
Give a partner or friend a space of their own, and a key to it.
[spoiler]
建成小屋后可命名，并获得三把对应钥匙。罗宾出售改名卡及补配钥匙，各 200 金；改名卡只用于命名，钥匙用于邀请。
Name a completed shed and receive three matching keys. Robin sells rename cards and replacement keys for 200g each.
 
六心可邀请小住，八心可邀请长居。不必提前标记床，但必须有实际可用床位。小住与长居分别设置夜间归来概率；未抽中不代表解除邀请。
Six hearts unlock short visits and eight hearts unlock residency. A real usable bed is required, but advance assignment is optional. Short-stay and resident arrival chances are configurable; missing a night does not revoke an invitation.
 
一个 NPC 只能绑定一间小屋。正式配偶只支持小住；莱纳斯只支持小住，概率固定 5%。当晚已有小屋预约的角色不会又被随机安排进农舍。
One NPC is bound to one shed. Official spouses are short-stay guests only. Linus is also short-stay only, with a fixed 5% chance. A nightly shed reservation prevents a second random farmhouse booking.
 
饱食或社交低于 30 会暂停小屋入住，二者都恢复至 60 后才回来。在小屋居住期间有每天额外两点好感。
Shed residency pauses if satiety or social drops below 30, and resumes when both reach 60. Living in a shed also grants two daily friendship points.
 
[b]新增伴侣小屋 / New companion shed[/b]
原版小屋外观，室内主空间右下方向外直接多出一间固定伴侣套房。建造条件沿用小屋，并多消耗一张伴侣套房图纸。可以更换样式或清空装修，但不能收回固定空间。
This building uses the vanilla Shed exterior, with a permanent suite attached directly outside the lower-right side of the main room. Construction follows Shed requirements plus one Companion Suite Blueprint. Change or clear the suite's decor; its fixed space cannot be collected.[/spoiler]
 
[size=5][b]ROOMS & FURNITURE · 区域与家具互动[/b][/size]
布置好空间，也为家具指定用途。
Plan your rooms and give furniture a role in daily life.
[spoiler]
罗宾出售区域规划图纸、家具规划图纸，各 500 金，可重复使用。区域可命名并选择客厅、卧室、厨房、卫生间或书房等类别；家具可指定为沙发、桌子、电视、书架、床、梳妆台、餐桌或浴缸。手持规划图纸时可查看标记。
Robin sells reusable Room and Furniture Planning Blueprints for 500g each. Name areas and choose room types, then assign furniture roles such as sofa, table, TV, bookshelf, bed, dresser, dining table or bathtub. Holding planning blueprints reveals their assignments.
 
符合条件的 NPC 可休息、发呆、看电视、阅读、短暂小睡、提出衣服或戒指建议、做饭及泡澡。做好的食物优先放到合适的餐桌，否则进入冰箱。睡前、休息或活动时会有对应头顶气泡。
Eligible NPCs can rest, daydream, watch TV, read, nap, suggest clothes or rings, cook and bathe. Cooked food goes to a suitable dining table or the refrigerator, with activity-related overhead reactions.
 
活动有前提：沙发需要可坐；电视附近需要合适沙发；部分阅读依赖玩家已有书籍；厨房互动需要可用厨房。家具的外观、可达性和角色素材会影响最终表现。
Activities have requirements: a sofa must be sittable, television needs a nearby suitable sofa, some reading depends on owned books, and cooking needs a usable kitchen. Furniture art, reachable positions and character sprites affect presentation.[/spoiler]
 
[size=5][b]SUITES & PATIOS · 伴侣房间与露台[/b][/size]
预览喜欢的样式，摆进自己的装修里。
Preview a partner's style and make it part of your home.
[spoiler]
有正式配偶或秘密伴侣后，可使用罗宾出售的伴侣套房图纸，500 金，放置时消耗。支持切换角色、房间／露台并预览；更换展示角色不改变真实关系。
With an official spouse or secret partner, use Robin's 500g Companion Suite Blueprint. It is consumed on placement. Preview partners and room or patio layouts without changing relationship status.
 
配偶房间仅可以放置于农舍或小屋；露台可放农场或小屋。支持处理原版配偶区域、更换样式、清空装饰保留空间，或收回普通放置区域并返还图纸。固定伴侣小屋套房不能收回。
Indoor suites belong in farmhouses or sheds. Patios can be placed on the farm or in sheds. Manage vanilla spouse areas, switch layouts, clear decor while keeping space, or collect ordinary placed areas to recover a blueprint. The companion shed's permanent suite cannot be collected.
 
露台支持叠放及更自由的选址。请预留 NPC 路线。区域内的家具、物品在收回时打包至附近箱子。
Patios support overlapping layouts and flexible placement. Leave walking room. Furniture and items are packed into a nearby chest when collecting an area.[/spoiler]
 
[size=5][b]FREE DAYS · 自由活动[/b][/size]
相处之外，也给他们一点自己的时间。
Time together, with room for a day of their own.
[spoiler]
开启 NPC 自由日后，符合条件的留宿 NPC、住客与正式配偶可能在次日采用新的活动安排，随机起床、出门，在农场或镇上走动。
With free days enabled, eligible overnight visitors, residents and the official spouse may follow a temporary activity plan, waking and heading out at varied times to spend time around the farm or town.
活动会协调当前预约、路线与室内互动，结束后恢复原安排。部分布局或其他接管 NPC 的 Mod 仍可能影响寻路，卡住恢复时可能出现位置调整。
Activities coordinate with reservations, routes and indoor interactions, then return control to normal behavior. Custom layouts or other NPC controllers can affect pathing, and recovery may reposition a stuck character.
 
GMCM 可关闭自由日。关闭后保留原版日程与留宿；当晚仍可先活动再睡，普通来客次日不留下，秘密伴侣最晚九点左右或按更早日程离开。
Disable free days in GMCM to retain ordinary schedules and overnight visits. Evening activity still works; ordinary guests leave the next morning, and secret partners leave by about 9 AM or earlier when their schedule requires it.[/spoiler]
 
[size=5][b]RESIDENT DIARY · 住客日程本[/b][/size]
一本书，记录大家逐渐积累的日常。
One book for the little details of everyone's day.
[spoiler]
首位入住者解锁共用日程本，后续住客加入同一本。正式配偶也在其中，不要求先邀请去小屋。可切换头像、点击日期翻阅历史、查看属性、当天时间轴和统计页。
The first invitation unlocks a shared diary; later residents join the same book. Your official spouse is included without a shed invitation. Switch portraits, browse past dates, inspect care values and read the timeline or summary page.
 
记录包含到访地点、早餐／午餐／晚餐／宵夜与收到的礼物；早餐和宵夜可能跳过。统计包括常去的地点、常吃的食物及常收到的礼物。历史保留约一个游戏年。
Entries include location changes, meals and received gifts, with breakfast or late snacks sometimes skipped. Summaries show frequent places, foods and gifts. History is retained for roughly one in-game year.
 
用餐条目包含系统生成的生活记录，不代表每一餐都实际消耗玩家的食材。当前尚无自定义句子、贴纸或导出墙饰功能。
Meal entries include generated daily flavor; they do not mean every meal physically consumes your ingredients. Sentence editing, stickers and framed exports are not implemented yet.[/spoiler]
 
[size=5][b]CARE & REACTIONS · 照料与回应[/b][/size]
聊天、分享一顿饭，看看今天的心情。
Talk, share a meal, and see how their day is going.
[spoiler]
照料属性为饱食、社交、心情，初始各 60，上限 100。饱食、社交每日有 -3～+3 的变化，心情每日下降 5。聊天增加社交；赠礼、分享美味、对话可改善心情。分享美味与送礼分开，每人每天限一次。
Care tracks satiety, social and mood, starting at 60 with a maximum of 100. Satiety and social vary by -3 to +3 daily; mood falls by 5. Talking raises social, while gifts, shared food and conversation improve mood. Sharing food is separate from gifting and is limited to once per NPC per day.
 
心情高时会出现开心、爱心等表情，较低时有愣住、否定或伤心反应。社交较高时更常向附近 NPC 或农场主打招呼；饱食达到 80 时，NPC 移速 +1。心情达到门槛的住客还可能在农舍门口附近留下礼物。
Higher mood produces cheerful or affectionate reactions, while low mood can bring hesitation or sadness. Higher social encourages greetings to nearby villagers or the farmer. Satiety of 80 grants the NPC +1 movement speed. Residents with sufficient mood may leave a gift near the farmhouse entrance.[/spoiler]
 
[size=5][b]CHARACTER PERKS · 角色专属加成[/b][/size]
34 位原版角色，各自用擅长的方式为你做点什么。
Unique perks for 34 vanilla characters, inspired by what they do best.
[spoiler]
正式配偶或符合条件的钥匙住客，三项照料属性全部达到 80 时激活自己的加成，任意一项不足即停用。不同角色的效果可以共存；旧版通用作物与幸运加成已被替换。模组 NPC 不自动套用原版角色加成。
An official spouse or eligible key-holding resident activates their perk when all three care values reach 80. It deactivates if any value falls below 80. Different characters' effects can coexist. These replace the old generic crop/luck perks; custom NPCs do not automatically inherit them.
 
HUD 可以展开／折叠常驻加成；折叠只隐藏图标。哈维储备体力与精心装扮倒计时可悬停查看。以下为当前效果，测试版可能继续调整平衡。
Expand or collapse persistent perk icons without disabling effects. Hover to read Harvey's stored stamina or the Dressed with Care timer. Current effects are listed below and may be rebalanced during Beta.
 
[b]爱芙琳 / Evelyn[/b]
花卉生长速度+25%；收获时50%额外获得一朵同品质花卉。
Flower growth speed +25%; 50% chance of one extra same-quality flower on harvest.
 
[b]克林特 / Clint[/b]
敲石头获得的石头、铜矿、铁矿、金矿、铱矿、煤有50%概率翻倍。
50% chance to double stone, copper, iron, gold, iridium and coal from breaking stones.
 
[b]格斯 / Gus[/b]
烹饪品质：普通10%、银星50%、金星30%、铱星10%；使用调料必为铱星。
Cooking quality: 10% normal, 50% silver, 30% gold, 10% iridium. Seasoning guarantees iridium.
 
[b]潘姆 / Pam[/b]
免除醉酒负面效果；醉酒期间速度+2。
Ignore tipsy penalties; speed +2 while tipsy.
 
[b]罗宾 / Robin[/b]
建筑及农舍升级金币费用-15%；锄地时20%额外获得黏土。
Building and house upgrade gold costs -15%; 20% chance of extra clay when hoeing.
 
[b]皮埃尔 / Pierre[/b]
购买种子附赠随机种子；周一商店随机一种金币商品半价。
Seed purchases include a random seed; one random gold-priced item is half price on Mondays.
 
[b]玛尼 / Marnie[/b]
动物心情下降减半；产品15%概率提升一档品质，最高铱星。
Animal mood loss halved; 15% chance to raise produce quality one tier, up to iridium.
 
[b]威利 / Willy[/b]
钓鱼条长度+15%；钓鱼技能+2。
Fishing bar +15%; fishing skill +2.
 
[b]刘易斯 / Lewis[/b]
完成布告栏求助任务至少获得一张兑奖券。
Help Wanted quests always award at least one prize ticket.
 
[b]卡洛琳 / Caroline[/b]
茶树茶叶产出翻倍；温室作物生长速度额外+15%。
Tea leaf harvests doubled; greenhouse crop growth speed +15%.
 
[b]乔治 / George[/b]
矿洞及火山中受到的伤害-20%。
Damage received in mines and volcano dungeons -20%.
 
[b]莱纳斯 / Linus[/b]
翻垃圾桶必有物品，且不因翻找垃圾降低他人好感。
Garbage cans always contain an item; no friendship penalty for searching them.
 
[b]贾斯 / Jas[/b]
赠送花卉带来的正向好感+50%。
Positive friendship from giving flowers +50%.
 
[b]文森特 / Vincent[/b]
钓鱼50%概率保留一份鱼饵；每次制作鱼饵额外+1。
50% chance to retain a bait when fishing; crafted bait output +1.
 
[b]乔迪 / Jodi[/b]
烹饪分别独立判定：50%额外产出一份，50%不消耗食材；调料仍消耗。
Independent cooking rolls: 50% extra output and 50% free ingredients. Seasonings are still consumed.
 
[b]德米 / Demetrius[/b]
果树成熟速度+20%；温室外非当季果树也可结果，挂果上限一颗；当季沿用原版上限三颗。
Fruit trees mature 20% faster. Outdoor out-of-season trees can hold one fruit; in-season trees retain the vanilla three-fruit capacity.
 
[b]肯特 / Kent[/b]
炸弹半径约+20%；受到的炸弹伤害-30%。
Bomb radius approximately +20%; bomb damage received -30%.
 
[b]法师 / Wizard[/b]
祝尼魔采收间隔加速15%；使用传送图腾后幸运+1，持续五分钟现实游戏推进时间。
Junimo harvest interval speed +15%; warp totems grant luck +1 for five real minutes while game time advances.
 
[b]矮人 / Dwarf[/b]
晶球掉落概率提高50%；制作炸弹分别有20%免材料、20%额外产出一枚。
Geode drop chance +50%; independent 20% chances of free bomb crafting materials and an extra bomb.
 
[b]科罗布斯 / Krobus[/b]
每种怪物基础掉落额外保底一份，原有概率照常；商店每日增加随机怪物商品。
One guaranteed item from each base monster drop type, plus normal rolls. Daily random monster shop stock.
 
[b]桑迪 / Sandy[/b]
桑迪商店买价-15%；每周邮寄店内随机商品十份。
Sandy's shop prices -15%; ten of one shop item mailed weekly.
 
[b]雷欧 / Leo[/b]
不受地形移速降低影响；火山怪物20%概率额外掉落一颗龙牙。
Ignore terrain slowing; 20% chance for volcano monsters to drop an extra dragon tooth.
 
[b]哈维 / Harvey[/b]
每两游戏分钟恢复一点体力；能量滋补水的溢出体力可储存，最多1000。体力低于10%时用储备补至50%。
Recover one stamina every two game minutes. Energy Tonic overflow is stored up to 1000; below 10%, stored energy restores stamina toward 50%.
 
[b]亚历克斯 / Alex[/b]
生命上限+50；受到怪物伤害后反伤50%，并有10%概率无伤格挡。
Maximum health +50; reflect 50% of received monster damage, with a 10% chance to block damage entirely.
 
[b]潘妮 / Penny[/b]
技能及精通经验+50%；五项技能满级后，求助任务金币+50%、正向好感+20%。
Skill and mastery experience +50%; after all five skills reach level 10, Help Wanted gold +50% and positive friendship +20%.
 
[b]阿比盖尔 / Abigail[/b]
攻击+30；矿洞及火山中速度+1。
Attack +30; speed +1 in mines and volcano dungeons.
 
[b]艾米丽 / Emily[/b]
裁衣50%概率不消耗布料；随机获得速度、幸运或防御+1，持续七个游戏日，各类不叠加。
50% chance to keep cloth when tailoring; random speed, luck or defense +1 for seven game days, each capped at one.
 
[b]莉亚 / Leah[/b]
斧头体力消耗减半；硬木掉落概率提高25%；森林采集或树倒时千分之一概率获得手工艺品。
Axe stamina cost halved; hardwood drop chance +25%; 0.1% chance of artwork from forest forage or a fallen tree.
 
[b]玛鲁 / Maru[/b]
工匠产品加工速度+20%；制作加工设备10%概率免材料。
Artisan processing speed +20%; 10% chance of free materials when crafting processing equipment.
 
[b]塞巴斯蒂安 / Sebastian[/b]
幸运+1；雨天或18点后速度+2，每五游戏分钟恢复一点体力。
Luck +1; in rain or after 6 PM, speed +2 and one stamina every five game minutes.
 
[b]山姆 / Sam[/b]
饮品持续时间翻倍；Joja可乐全部效果三倍；饮用后额外速度+1。
Drink duration doubled; all Joja Cola effects tripled; additional speed +1 after drinking.
 
[b]谢恩 / Shane[/b]
每份动物产品额外+1；每日抚摸额外增加五点动物好感，自动抚摸也生效。
Animal produce output +1; petting grants five extra friendship daily, including auto-petters.
 
[b]艾利欧特 / Elliott[/b]
蟹笼每份产出额外+1；海滩可能出现装有稀有物品的漂流瓶。
Each crab pot output +1; the beach may contain a drift bottle with a rare item.
 
[b]海莉 / Haley[/b]
夏季作物生长速度+30%；离开建筑时15%获得精心装扮，持续十分钟现实游戏推进时间。
Summer crop growth +30%; 15% chance of Dressed with Care when leaving a building, lasting ten real minutes while the game advances.
 [/spoiler]
 
[size=5][b]STORIES, GIFTS & LETTERS · 剧情、礼物与来信[/b][/size]
把具体的惊喜留在折叠区里。
Open the spoiler below for story and reward details.
[spoiler]
[b]山顶 / The Summit[/b]
达到完美后可选择一位秘密伴侣参与山顶剧情。山顶解锁后，与符合入住条件的秘密伴侣分享美味还可能约好次日登山，在观景处触发随机对白并收到食物与物品。部分对白受是否已有正式配偶影响。
After reaching Perfection, choose a secret partner for the Summit scene. Once the Summit is unlocked, sharing food with an eligible resident secret partner may arrange a next-day visit, with random dialogue and food/item gifts. Some dialogue depends on whether you have an official spouse.
 
[b]晨间与动态睡眠 / Mornings and dynamic sleep[/b]
可选玩家动态睡眠，根据入睡时间随机睡 6～15 小时，最早六点醒来。部分留宿互动可请求对方次晨多留一会；若你尚未醒来而对方必须离开，可能留下附礼物的信。
Optional farmer dynamic sleep selects 6–15 hours of rest, never waking earlier than 6 AM. Some overnight interactions let you ask a partner to linger the next morning. If you are still asleep when they must leave, a gift-bearing letter may remain.
 
[b]来信 / Letters[/b]
包含晴天早安信、塞巴斯蒂安雨天信等。Letters include a sunny good morning and a rainy Sebastian letter.
 
[b]礼物来源 / Gift provenance[/b]
部分物品记录赠送者，获得时有提示。回赠本人、转赠他人会有不同反应，部分转赠可能被退回并影响好感；自动赠礼有可配置数量上限。
Some gifts retain their giver and show a provenance notice. Returning or regifting them can trigger different reactions, including rejection and friendship consequences. Automatic gifts have configurable daily limits.
 
[b]姜岛与帮忙 / Ginger Island and chores[/b]
保留秘密伴侣的姜岛来电、来访及陪伴安排，以及可关闭的夜间农场帮忙。它们不是完整的七种任务劳作。
Secret-partner island calls, visits and companionship remain available, along with optional overnight farm help. This is not a full farm-task worker.[/spoiler]
 
[size=5][b]SETTINGS & INSTALLATION · 设置与安装[/b][/size]
[list]
1.运行环境 / Requirements: Stardew Valley 1.6.x，SMAPI 4.3.2 或更高。当前开发检查使用本机游戏程序集。Stardew Valley 1.6.x and SMAPI 4.3.2 or newer[/list][list]
2.推荐 / Recommended: Generic Mod Config Menu（GMCM），用于调整自由日、留宿、概率、同床、动态睡眠与赠礼上限。Use GMCM to configure free days, visits, sharing, sleep and gift limits.[/list][list]
3.更新 / Updating: 退出游戏后替换旧文件，备份存档、config.json 及自定义台词。Exit before updating and retain your saves, config and custom dialogue backups.[/list][list]
4.版本选择 / Editions: Full 与 Lite 二选一，不要同时安装多个 Secret Marriage。Lite 主要提供秘密关系基础功能；本页居住、规划、自由日、角色加成等扩展属于 Full。Install Full or Lite, not both. The expanded housing, planning, free-day and perk systems on this page belong to Full.[/list][list]
5.自定义 / Custom text: 提供中文、英文文本，部分台词可通过 Dialogues 文件调整。Chinese and English text are included; selected dialogue can be customized through the Dialogues folder.[/list] 
[size=5][b]COMPATIBILITY & FEEDBACK · 兼容与反馈[/b][/size]
仍在测试。目前与SVE、SDS等大型模组兼容。
Still in testing. Currently compatible with large modules like SVE and SDS.[/center]
